feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 3 September 2026 6:19am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

West or SW 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in a few places, then becoming generally 5 or 6 later tonight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later tonight.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain arriving from the west this afternoon, clearing tonight.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

West or SW 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 tomorrow morning, then soon becoming 5 or 6 again in the afternoon. Gradually decreasing West 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, moderate or rough for a time, then gradually falling slight later.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Saturday, 5 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

West 3 or 4, gradually back South through the day, then increasing 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, building moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then patchy rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Sunday, 6 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

South 5 or 6, possibly 6 or 7 for a time, then veering and decreasing West or SW 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough, then falling slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain for a time, then fair.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 19°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Monday, 7 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing.


##Wind)##

West or SW 4 or 5, increasing SW 5 or 6.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate.


##Weather)##

Fair, then patchy rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
